content.text: the Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy, which addresses how housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions

.

The policy document does address screening restrictions related to criminal history and credit considerations, but does not contain provisions regarding the other rental housing obligations you asked about (rent caps, just cause eviction, deposits, application/screening fees, or algorithmic pricing).

To obtain information about those specific rental housing obligations and exemptions in Boston as of October 1, 2026, you would need additional source documents beyond this fair chance tenant selection policy.
